makeupLooks.label: Daytime Natural
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: soft brown mascara, champagne eyeshadow wash, taupe tightline eyeliner. Face / Cheeks: peach cream blush, subtle pearlescent liquid highlighter. Lips: tinted berry lip balm, sheer dusty rose lip oil.

makeupLooks.label: Night Time Elegant
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: jet black gel eyeliner with a crisp wing, warm espresso matte eyeshadow, volumizing black mascara. Face / Cheeks: sculpted cool-taupe contour, soft terracotta powder blush. Lips: classic deep crimson red satin lipstick, matching brick red lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Party
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: holographic silver glitter shadow topper, charcoal smudged eyeliner, intense black fiber mascara. Face / Cheeks: radiant bronze liquid bronzer, vibrant coral powder blush. Lips: glossy fuchsia liquid lip, mauve lip gloss.

makeupLooks.label: Portrait Shoot
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: warm neutral matte taupe eyeshadow, chocolate brown pencil eyeliner, wispy black individual falsies. Face / Cheeks: soft velvet rose blush, matte translucent setting powder, subtle golden-neutral powder highlighter. Lips: defined warm nude-pink velvet lipstick, cinnamon brown lip pencil.

makeupLooks.label: Sun-Kissed Coastal
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: warm bronze cream eyeshadow, copper metallic eyeliner along the lower lash line, dark brown waterproof mascara. Face / Cheeks: golden-terracotta liquid blush, luminous warm champagne highlighter, sun-swept warm matte bronzer across the nose bridge. Lips: glossy warm caramel lip oil, nude peach satin lipstick.

makeupLooks.label: Dark Editorial / Grunge
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: matte black kohl eyeliner blown-out and smudged, cool slate-gray eyeshadow wash, carbon black clumpy mascara. Face / Cheeks: muted mauve powder blush, cool-toned ash contour powder. Lips: matte deep blackberry lipstick, dark plum lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Minimalist Monochrome
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: soft terracotta-pink cream shadow, clear brow gel, fluttery brown lengthening mascara. Face / Cheeks: terracotta-pink multi-use stick applied high on cheekbones, satin skin tint base. Lips: terracotta-pink lip stain blotted softly at the center, clear gloss topper.

makeupLooks.label: Vintage Classic (1950s / Retro)
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: matte vanilla cream eyeshadow base, sharp liquid black cat-eye eyeliner, defined black separation mascara. Face / Cheeks: soft petal pink powder blush, velvety matte porcelain powder. Lips: true blue-red matte lipstick, sharp cherry red lip pencil.

makeupLooks.label: Electric Festival / Pop
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: cobalt blue graphic liquid eyeliner, iridescent lilac inner-corner highlight, bright white waterline pencil, jet black mascara. Face / Cheeks: dewy neon-pink cream blush, holographic duochrome violet highlighter. Lips: semi-sheer frosted baby pink lip gloss, cool neutral lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Classic Siren (Smokey & Bold)
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: matte chocolate-brown and black gradient smokey shadow, black gel waterline liner, dense black volume mascara. Face / Cheeks: sculpted cool-brown contour, soft peach-tan velvet blush, subtle champagne-gold highlight on high points. Lips: matte deep wine-burgundy lipstick, dark oxblood lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Smoldering Bronze (Lived-in & Warm)
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: metallic deep bronze cream shadow, smudged coffee-brown kohl pencil, generous coats of dark brown volumizing mascara. Face / Cheeks: sunken bronze cream contour, warm amber liquid blush, dewy golden highlighter. Lips: glossy cinnamon-caramel lip lacquer, warm chestnut lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Bedroom Eyes / Velvet Noir
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: blown-out charcoal shadow halo, soft matte taupe transition, smudged soft-black pencil along the lash line, fluttery black corner lashes. Face / Cheeks: muted dusky-rose powder blush, soft-focus matte translucent powder, neutral beige satin bronzer. Lips: velvet matte honey-nude lipstick, cool deep-nude lip liner subtly over-lined.

makeupLooks.label: Dark Temptation / Siren Noir
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: glossy black eyelid wash, smudge-soft charcoal pencil blended out, spidery jet-black lengthening mascara. Face / Cheeks: sculpted cool-stone contour under cheekbones, sheer satin rosewood blush, dewy glass-skin highlight on high points. Lips: high-shine dark cherry / black cherry tinted lacquer, deep plum lip pencil.

makeupLooks.label: Gilded Bronze Goddess
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: metallic melted bronze foil shadow, blended molten copper lower lash line, dark chocolate-brown fiber mascara. Face / Cheeks: sun-drenched warm terra-bronzer across forehead and cheeks, rich apricot liquid blush, warm champagne-gold liquid strobe. Lips: glossy warm caramel lip oil over a warm chestnut lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Smudged Rock 'n' Roll Glam
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: lived-in diffuse black kohl pencil along top and bottom waterlines, soft metallic taupe transition shadow, carbon black mascara. Face / Cheeks: demi-matte finish, cool-neutral contour, soft dusty mauve flush on apples of cheeks. Lips: blotted nude-beige satin lipstick, neutral taupe lip pencil softly blurred.

makeupLooks.label: Monochromatic Spiced Plum
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: satin cranberry-plum shadow wash with darker espresso in outer corners, wine-toned gel pencil, black volumizing mascara. Face / Cheeks: soft plum-mauve cream blush draped up the temples, muted champagne powder highlighter. Lips: velvety matte rich blackberry-mauve lipstick, deep wine lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Ethereal Soft-Focus Sultry
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: hazy matte espresso shadow focused along the lash base, subtle champagne pearl in inner corners, wispy outer-corner flutter lashes. Face / Cheeks: muted peach-tan velvet blush, blurred soft-focus setting powder, soft neutral-glow highlighter. Lips: creamy cashmere-nude lipstick, warm cinnamon-nude pencil lightly overlining the cupid's bow.

makeupLooks.label: Vampy Plum & Gold
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: metallic burnished-gold eye shadow on the inner two-thirds of the eyelid, smudged deep plum-violet eyeshadow winged out at the outer corner, dark plum gel liner along the upper waterline, jet-black mascara. Face / Cheeks: sculpted cool-brown contour under the cheekbones, muted deep berry-rose blush, pale gold cream highlighter on high points. Lips: high-shine dark black-plum gloss over a precise deep oxblood lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Siren Eye / Espresso Smudge
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: extended espresso-brown gel liner drawn into an elongated inner-corner and sharp outer wing, smudged slightly with matte dark chocolate eyeshadow, translucent champagne shimmer wash across the lid, brown separation mascara. Face / Cheeks: golden-bronze cream bronzer buffed high on the cheeks, warm terracotta liquid blush, dewy wet-look clear highlight balm. Lips: velvet-matte warm taupe-nude lipstick framed by a deep cinnamon-brown lip liner softly diffused inward.

makeupLooks.label: Smokey Emerald
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: deep jewel-toned metallic emerald eyeshadow buffed across the mobile lid, blended into a matte charcoal-grey crease, matte black liner smudged along both top and bottom lash lines, volumizing black fiber mascara. Face / Cheeks: neutral matte bronzer, sheer neutral beige powder blush on the apples of the cheeks, subtle champagne-beige powder highlighter. Lips: sheer glossy peach-nude lip oil over a cool neutral nude lip pencil.

makeupLooks.label: Midnight Navy & Nude
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: metallic midnight-blue shadow wash across the lid, crisp matte black liquid liner wing, bright white pencil in the waterline, intense jet-black mascara. Face / Cheeks: soft rosewood powder blush draped toward the temples, neutral contour powder, pearlescent icy-gold highlighter. Lips: creamy satin honey-nude lipstick paired with a milk-chocolate brown lip liner.

makeupLooks.label: Soft Terracotta Glow
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: matte soft terracotta shadow washed across the eyelid, brown mascara, subtle champagne highlight on the inner corners. Face / Cheeks: warm terracotta cream blush on the apples of the cheeks and slightly over the bridge of the nose. Lips: tinted terracotta lip oil or a blotted warm nude balm.

makeupLooks.label: Rosy Fresh Face
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: sheer wash of satin rose-gold eyeshadow, tightlined upper lash line with a soft brown pencil, one coat of lengthening mascara. Face / Cheeks: sheer pink liquid blush on the high points of the cheeks, natural skin-like liquid highlighter. Lips: sheer dusty-rose tinted lip balm or glossy lip stain.

makeupLooks.label: Clean Girl Minimalist
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: groomed brushed-up clear brow gel, curled lashes with clear or light brown mascara, no eyeshadow. Face / Cheeks: subtle peachy-nude cream blush blended into a dewy skin tint, no powder, glass-skin finish. Lips: sheer nude lip gloss or a hydrating lip mask.

makeupLooks.label: Monochromatic Peach
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: light sweep of matte peach eyeshadow across the lid and along the lower lash line, soft brown mascara. Face / Cheeks: soft peach powder blush swept upward toward the temples. Lips: satin peach-nude lipstick blotted softly with a fingertip.

makeupLooks.label: Effortless French-Girl Chic
makeupLooks.phrase: Eyes: bare eyelid with a clean subtle brown pencil wing on the outer corner, well-defined black mascara. Face / Cheeks: light dust of bronzer for warmth, subtle matte berry-tinted blush. Lips: blotted satin berry or muted rose-red lipstick with a diffused soft edge.

realismBlock: Ultra-realistic skin texture: visible pores, follicle marks, fine peach fuzz and vellus hair catching the light unevenly across the visible skin, subtle natural color variation, faint freckling, and soft micro-imperfections rather than airbrushed smoothness. Hair shows individual strands with natural flyaways, soft frizz, and subtle baby hairs at the hairline, with healthy but imperfect texture and light reflecting through it rather than a flat CGI sheen. Eyes with natural catchlights, subtle moisture, realistic iris striation, and authentic sclera tone. Tangible micro-textures on fabrics, crisp stitching, and natural fabric creases.
exclusionsImage: Keep extra people, disembodied hands, extra limbs, plastic skin, beauty filters, and cartoonish rendering out of the frame.
